scheme_name: Conversion/Modernisation of Mechanised Fishing Boats for Deep Sea Fishing
other_conditions: Must be a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society
Must not have received Old Age Pension from the department
Must not be employed in Government, Government Undertakings, or Fishermen Co-operative Society
Must have no dues payable to the Department or Fishermen Co-operative Societies at the time of application
The mechanised boat must be registered
Hull must be extended above 47 feet with specified equipment (hydraulic winch, steel ropes, GPS, echo sounder, insulated ice-box, life-saving appliances, etc.)
Must have obtained a provisional loan sanction order from the bank
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy up to ₹2,50,000 per boat linked to bank finance.
